paths.description: Homepage and content listing: entry purpose, navigation, performance, preferences, responsive behavior and metadata.
Representative category archive/listing template; other tag and pagination archives were not duplicated because they share this template.
Representative video detail and primary watch journey, including embedded player and commercial overlays.
Invalid URL and empty search-result recovery states; checkout/account flows were not covered because the site exposes none.

findings.summary: Advertisements obscure the detail page before its content
findings.evidence: The 360x800 detail screenshot shows the entire first viewport filled by stacked gambling banners plus floating edge ads; the requested video is not visible.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove load-time floating ads and sharply reduce above-content banners. If a necessary notice must overlay content, use a semantic, labelled, light-dismissible dialog or popover.

findings.summary: Commercial chrome competes with the content
findings.evidence: The home mobile screenshot puts three large affiliate banners ahead of the page heading, while the detail page contains many more banners.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve the first viewport for the site purpose and primary content; defer or remove repetitive affiliate creative.

findings.summary: Floating ads use ad-hoc overlays rather than semantic controls
findings.evidence: The detail screenshot shows floating edge banners with tiny close glyphs; the DOM probe found no dialog or popover primitives.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace any necessary transient overlay with popover/dialog semantics, a labelled button, keyboard focus handling, and platform light-dismiss.

findings.summary: The primary watch flow is buried behind advertising
findings.evidence: Following a homepage card to the representative detail page leads to a first viewport containing only advertisements; users must scroll substantially before reaching the embedded player.
findings.suggestedFix: Place the selected title and player immediately after compact navigation, and move proportionate advertising below the primary content.

findings.evidence: The platform probe found no view-transition CSS or API use on this multi-page listing/detail experience.
findings.suggestedFix: Add same-origin cross-document View Transitions with a reduced-motion fallback for navigation between cards and details.

findings.summary: Mobile LCP misses the good threshold
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured mobile LCP at 3.7s (score 0.57), although the warm desktop trace measured 1.42s.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP asset, reduce render-blocking CSS, avoid competing banners above it, and verify LCP below 2.5s on mobile.

findings.summary: Render-blocking and cache inefficiencies delay content
findings.evidence: HAR confirms four parser-inserted VeryHigh-priority stylesheets and blocking jQuery/jQuery Migrate; Lighthouse estimates 520ms render-blocking savings and 809KiB cache savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Inline only critical CSS, defer non-critical styles and scripts, remove jQuery Migrate if unnecessary, use font-display, and set durable immutable caching for versioned assets.

findings.summary: The page ships avoidable CSS and JavaScript
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 63KiB unused CSS, 68KiB unused JavaScript, 5KiB unminified CSS, and 8KiB unminified JavaScript.
findings.suggestedFix: Build per-template bundles, purge unused framework/icon rules, minify authored assets, and load carousel/search code only where used.

findings.summary: Accessible names and media semantics are incomplete
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports 25 label-content-name mismatches. Both search inputs have no associated label, and the detail iframe has an empty title.
findings.suggestedFix: Make aria-label text include the visible card text, add explicit search labels, and give the player iframe a descriptive title.

findings.summary: Zoom is disabled and embedded video lacks an accessible equivalent
findings.evidence: The viewport declares maximum-scale=1 and user-scalable=no; Lighthouse fails meta-viewport. The representative player is an untitled iframe with no discoverable caption track in the page DOM.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove maximum-scale and user-scalable restrictions. Require captions/transcripts for video and expose a titled player with accessible controls.

findings.evidence: The image primitive found 42 of 45 images without width/height; Lighthouse also flags unsized card images.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit width and height (or a stable aspect-ratio) from media metadata for every logo, card thumbnail, and banner.

findings.evidence: The detail probe returned a unique title and canonical URL but no meta description, while the homepage has one.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate a concise, unique meta description for each detail page from its visible summary.

findings.evidence: The headers primitive confirms HTTPS but no CSP, HSTS, or X-Content-Type-Options; analytics cookies are also not Secure and use SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Add HSTS, a restrictive CSP, nosniff, and issue first-party analytics cookies with Secure and an appropriate SameSite value.

findings.summary: Persistent analytics runs without visible consent or minimisation
findings.evidence: Tracker evidence found Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics; two analytics cookies last 400 days and the HAR attributes 166,615 bytes to GTM. No consent control appeared on load.
findings.suggestedFix: Use consent-gated, data-minimised analytics, shorten retention, avoid session-wide tracking by default, and document the third-party purpose.

findings.evidence: Headers show no clickjacking protection, Permissions-Policy, CSP frame-ancestors, or HSTS; Referrer-Policy remains no-referrer-when-downgrade.
findings.suggestedFix: Set CSP frame-ancestors, Permissions-Policy, strict-origin-when-cross-origin (or stricter), HSTS, and consider Trusted Types for script-injection-sensitive code.

findings.summary: Image-only gambling promotions are difficult to identify and dominate the core flow
findings.evidence: The detail screenshot shows numerous gambling promotions, several floating over content; the detail probe lists many outbound short-link affiliates whose anchors have no visible text.
findings.suggestedFix: Clearly label every advertisement and destination, remove disguised/floating promotions, avoid opaque short links, and keep dismiss controls large and predictable.

findings.evidence: The image audit found 35 below-fold images not lazy-loaded, 36 without srcset, eight legacy-format assets, and oversized logo/banner assets; Lighthouse estimates 802KiB image savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Lazy-load below-fold thumbnails, provide responsive srcset/sizes, convert animated GIF/banner assets to efficient formats, and right-size the logo.

findings.summary: Advertising, trackers and animated banners consume a disproportionate budget
findings.evidence: The homepage transfers 1.39MB; 862KB is images and 166KB is GTM. Screenshots show repeated animated/commercial banners before content.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a per-template media and third-party budget, defer non-essential ads, cap ad slots, and replace animated GIFs with efficient, user-controlled media.

findings.summary: Long pages provide no position-aware navigation aid
findings.evidence: The homepage is 7,136px tall at mobile width, while screenshots and CSS inspection show static chrome and no scroll-state query or progress indicator.
findings.suggestedFix: For long listing/detail pages, provide a lightweight scroll-state-aware header or progress/back-to-top affordance without obscuring content.

Add security headers and secure cookie settings
Restore zoom and accessible player semantics
Improve LCP and critical resource delivery
Add position-aware guidance for long pages
